common_name: Encore Autumn Amethyst Azalea (Reblooming Purple-Lavender Azalea)

planting.note: Plant container shrubs in spring or fall in moist, well-drained, acidic (pH 4.5-6.0), humus-rich soil in partial shade with at least 4 hours of direct sun; Autumn Amethyst is a compact, mounding Encore variety well suited to foundation plantings, mixed borders, and large containers.

directions: Plant in moist, well-drained, acidic (pH 4.5-6.0), humus-rich soil in partial shade with 4-6 hours of direct sun for the strongest rebloom; Encore Autumn Amethyst produces semi-double, rich purple-lavender flowers in a heavy spring flush and then again in smaller bursts through summer and fall. The compact, dense, mounding habit fits neatly into foundation plantings and smaller garden beds without the need for frequent pruning. As with other Encore azaleas, more direct sun than traditional spring-only azaleas need is required for dependable fall rebloom, so avoid deep, all-day shade. Water deeply during dry spells, mulch to keep roots cool and moist, and fertilize with an acid-forming fertilizer after the spring bloom flush to support the later rebloom cycles.

common_name: Encore Autumn Twist Azalea (Reblooming Pink-and-White Bicolor Azalea)

planting.note: Plant container shrubs in spring or fall in moist, well-drained, acidic (pH 4.5-6.0), humus-rich soil in partial shade with at least 4 hours of direct sun; Autumn Twist is grown for its striped, bicolor blooms and benefits from the same sun exposure other Encore azaleas need to rebloom well.

directions: Plant in moist, well-drained, acidic (pH 4.5-6.0), humus-rich soil in partial shade with 4-6 hours of direct sun to support strong repeat bloom. Encore Autumn Twist is notable among reblooming azaleas for its striped, swirled pink-and-white flowers, with individual blossoms and even individual plants varying in the exact pattern and proportion of color, giving each shrub an informal, painterly look in the landscape. It flowers heavily in spring and produces smaller rebloom flushes through summer and into fall, provided it gets enough direct sun. Water deeply during dry periods, keep a layer of mulch over the shallow, fibrous root system, and feed with an acid-forming fertilizer after the spring bloom to encourage continued flowering later in the season.

common_name: Encore Autumn Bonfire Azalea (Compact Reblooming Red-Orange Azalea)

planting.note: Plant container shrubs in spring or fall in moist, well-drained, acidic (pH 4.5-6.0), humus-rich soil in partial shade with at least 4 hours of direct sun; Autumn Bonfire is one of the more compact Encore varieties, well suited to small beds, foundation plantings, and containers.

directions: Plant in moist, well-drained, acidic (pH 4.5-6.0), humus-rich soil in partial shade with 4-6 hours of direct sun for the most reliable rebloom. Encore Autumn Bonfire is a compact, dense reblooming azalea bearing vivid red-orange flowers in a heavy spring flush and then intermittently again through summer and fall, giving three seasons of color from one small shrub. Its tight, mounding habit keeps it well proportioned for foundation plantings, small courtyard gardens, and large containers without regular pruning. Like other Encore azaleas it needs more direct sun than traditional spring-only azaleas to rebloom well, so avoid deep shade sites. Keep the shallow root zone consistently moist with mulch, and fertilize with an acid-forming fertilizer after the spring bloom flush to support later flowering.
